description: This file declares the WebSocketChannel class, which provides a transport-independent implementation of WebSocket protocol semantics, including connection management, data frame handling, and handshake procedures. It is part of the net namespace and interfaces with WebSocket streams and events.

classes.name: WebSocketChannel
classes.description: A class implementing a transport-independent WebSocket protocol handler, managing connection states, data frames, handshakes, and errors.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequest
methods.description: Initiates the WebSocket connection process with specified URL, protocols, and headers.

methods.name: SendFrame
methods.description: Sends a data frame to the remote endpoint, ensuring send quota and message validity.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads incoming WebSocket frames from the stream.

methods.name: StartClosingHandshake
methods.description: Begins the WebSocket closing handshake with a status code and reason.

methods.name: SendAddChannelRequestForTesting
methods.description: Starts connection with a custom stream request callback, used for testing.

methods.name: SetClosingHandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom timeout for the closing handshake, mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetUnderlyingConnectionCloseTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom timeout for underlying connection close, mainly for testing.

methods.name: OnStartOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Handles the event when the WebSocket opening handshake begins.
